body.name: Rule closure
body.construction: \(\operatorname{Cl}_{\mathcal R}(\mathcal O)\) is initialized with every skeleton and every unshielded collider in the complete regime-MAG signatures on \(U_k\). The observational component is associated with \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\); each non-observational signature is supplied by \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\) and includes all \(\zeta_k\)-involving instances. It treats this full input signature as immutable premises and repeatedly applies every instance of every rule in \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{SI}}\) until no reported observed circle endpoint changes.
